approval_source.question_set: Whether the kill command restarts the node by itself after a delay

reason: In round 22 of the first staging fault campaign (4 November 2026, UTC), the founder's machine lost its network between sending the validator's kill and its restart, so the single-validator staging chain halted for about 70 minutes until a retry sent the restart. The network faults already clear themselves on the host (a netem dead-man timer, an nftables timeout set); the kill had nothing like it.

decisions.question: Whether the kill command restarts the node by itself after a delay
decisions.rule: fault-kill first clears any kill dead-man still pending from an earlier kill, then arms a one-time 60-second timer on the host (dytallix-kill-restart) that starts the node, then kills the node's main process; its last step stays the read-only proof. The founder's start normally comes first, and the timer's start is then a no-op; if that start fails, the timer is a second start. stop cancels a pending timer first, so a node stopped on purpose stays stopped; start never cancels it. A kill scenario whose founder restart failed still fails, even when the timer brought the node back, so a failing start is never hidden. The CI fault drill proves it with a kill and no restart, and the host must start the node itself. The agents on the staging hosts are updated in place with the new allowlist after the reruns of 4 and 5 November 2026, as on 4 November (P01_T06_AGENT_POLL_FREE_TIER_2026-11-04), keeping their state.

accepted_risks: A start the founder wanted withheld after a kill still happens 60 seconds later unless a stop is sent; every kill on the allowlist is followed by a restart, so no planned step wants that.
A failing founder start, the startup failure seen in CI on 4 November 2026, still fails its scenario; the timer only keeps the chain from staying halted.
does_not_authorize: removing and reinstalling an agent, or installing one on another host
any agent command beyond the allowlist
any run on a real host beyond the fault campaign rounds already approved
